name: adb-assistant
description: ADB 桌面助手 - 现代化 Android 设备管理工具
author: xiaoyang

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5273 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test:weaknet:cleanup: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/weaknet-proxy-cleanup-regression.cjs --watch ui-shots/_proxyclean.log --until "PROXY CLEANUP REGRESSION DONE"
scripts.check:drag-install: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-drag-install.cjs --watch ui-shots/_draginstall.log --until "DRAG INSTALL CHECK DONE" --timeout 600
scripts.check:update: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-update.cjs --watch ui-shots/_update.log --until "UPDATE CHECK DONE" --timeout 900
scripts.check:asar-stage: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-asar-stage.cjs --watch ui-shots/_asar-stage.log --until "ASAR STAGE CHECK DONE" --timeout 300
scripts.check:aab-ui: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-aab-ui.cjs --watch ui-shots/_aab-ui.log --until "AAB UI CHECK DONE" --timeout 600
scripts.check:aab-ui:installed: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-aab-ui.cjs --watch ui-shots/_aab-ui.log --until "AAB UI CHECK DONE" --timeout 600 -- --installed
scripts.check:drag-install:installed:electron: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-drag-install.cjs --watch ui-shots/_draginstall-installed.log --until "DRAG INSTALL CHECK DONE" --timeout 900 -- --installed
scripts.check:install-modes: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-install-modes.cjs --watch ui-shots/_installmodes.log --until "INSTALL MODES CHECK DONE" --timeout 600
scripts.check:quick-actions: python scripts/run-electron.py scripts/check-quick-actions.cjs --watch ui-shots/_quickactions.log --until "QUICK ACTION CHECK DONE" --timeout 600
